messages:
mike: FYI: small uptick in partial-stream responses this AM (~1.1% of sessions). Alert fired at 08:12 UTC.

ana: Checking traces: first token + handshake OK, then clients stall for 3-6s before reconnect. Looks like idle detection or heartbeat mismatch.

devon: I can reproduce on canary with packet-loss sim. Observed KV-cache evictions and async-decoder fallback to CPU right before freeze.

nina: I'll run a quick canary: lower stream idle timeout, add heartbeat pings. I can own rollout and monitoring.

mike: Assign: nina -> canary mitigation (48h), devon -> deeper RC investigation (5d), ana -> SLA impact report and post-canary verification (72h).

ana: Canary config to test in staging: stream.keepalive_interval_ms=12000, stream.idle_threshold_ms=25000, client.reconnect_policy=linear(200,400,800). Enabling verbose streaming traces for 72h.

devon: I'll add eviction counters and async-worker latency histograms. If eviction correlates, plan to increase pinning and soften eviction during active requests.

ops-bot: Launched synthetic job `synthetic/streaming-heartbeat-check` every 6h -> posts to #eng-oncall.

nina: Canary rollout plan: staging -> 10% (6h) -> 50% (12h) -> 100% if stable. Abort if partials >0.5% or errors +0.2%.

mike: Also add recurring correlation job to check deployments and pods with short terminationGracePeriod (pattern). ana owns weekly checks for 4 weeks.

ana: I'll write a short runbook for oncall: where to find traces, quick triage steps, metrics to watch. Adding action items to tracker.

mike: Will check back in 48h in this thread with mitigation results. Thanks all. :rocket:
